scenePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original illustrated landscape background for the opening cinematic of a Chinese Journey to the West side-scrolling game. Primary request: Flower Fruit Mountain at dawn, the seaside mountain where the stone monkey is born, evoking the wonder and theatrical mood of the classic Chinese television adaptation while matching refined painterly fantasy game art. Wide 16:9 composition, approximately 1536 pixels wide. A dramatic rocky coastal mountaintop terrace occupies the bottom third, its flat summit centered at 44 percent of the image width and 72 percent of its height, leaving an open landing surface for a separately animated sacred boulder and monkey. DO NOT paint the sacred boulder or any character on the terrace. Behind it are lush steep green karst mountains, a delicate waterfall at the left, distant ocean and pale blue morning sky with soft peach-gold sunlight, wisps of white mountain mist. A wind-shaped pine on the far right frames the scene without obscuring the central terrace or upper sky. Composition must read clearly at a small game resolution of 384x216. Detailed hand-painted stone, warm atmospheric light, jade green foliage, turquoise sea, gold mist, restrained cinematic colors. Landscape only: no people, monkeys, palaces, writing, letters, titles, logos, borders or watermark. Entire canvas filled with artwork, no transparency. Do not recreate a television still or an actor's face.
spritesPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for an original Journey to the West stone-monkey birth game cinematic. Primary request: Exactly THREE isolated cutouts in THREE equal vertical columns on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Each column is 512 pixels wide; keep generous transparent padding and never cross column boundaries. Column 1 on the left: one complete upright sacred egg-shaped BOULDER with rough blue-grey granite, subtle jade moss, dark natural fissures and restrained warm gold glints inside one central crack, flattened bottom to stand on a rock ledge. The boulder is about 400 pixels wide and 690 pixels high, centered at x256 with its base at y920. No loose stones, no scenery, no background. Column 2 in the middle: one newborn STONE MONKEY springing upward to the right, arms raised energetically, knees bent in a powerful airborne leap, long curved monkey tail. Entire body and all limbs must be visible, no staff, no crown, no armor. Column 3 on the right: the SAME stone monkey after landing, standing alert in a broad-footed playful pose facing three-quarters right, one hand shading the eyes as he looks around and the other slightly open, complete body and long tail. Both monkeys have soft chestnut-gold fur, an expressive pale monkey muzzle, small tuft of hair, strong youthful athletic build and a modest short leaf-and-brown-cloth wrap at the waist. They are recognizable Chinese mythic stone monkeys, not human actors or modern cartoon mascots, not chibi. Both monkey poses are about 620 pixels tall, consistently scaled, centered in their own columns with foot baselines near y920. Same refined detailed hand-painted fantasy game finish as a gold-armored Sun Wukong character, but this is the unarmored newborn monkey. Warm rim light, natural anatomy and clean alpha edges. No grid, labels, text, weapons, magic swirls, ground shadows, backdrop, opaque black, logos or watermark. Genuine transparent background everywhere outside the three cutouts.
spriteEditPrompt: Edit the attached sprite atlas ONLY to fix its layout and cutout transparency for production use. Preserve the same boulder, the same brown-gold newborn monkey design and both poses, the same leaf waist wrap and painting finish. Arrange them as THREE SMALLER fully separated subjects in THREE equal vertical columns of a 1536x1024 canvas: boulder center x256, airborne monkey center x768, standing monkey center x1280. Each subject must fit inside its own x range with at least 70px empty padding from the cell boundaries, including tails and fingertips. Uniformly scale down each complete subject rather than cropping it; monkeys should be the same body scale. The LEFT rock cannot touch the MIDDLE tail; the MIDDLE monkey's right hand and tail cannot overlap or enter the RIGHT monkey's cell. Keep all feet and all tails fully visible. CRITICAL: remove every golden/brown/grey halo, glow, studio gradient, lighting backdrop, fog and cast shadow around the subjects. Outside the exact subjects, every pixel must be truly transparent with zero alpha, including the gaps between arms, legs and tail. Opaque solid subject interiors with antialiased clean alpha edges only. No background color, no new effects, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no text, no labels. This is a clean three-cutout game sprite sheet, not a presentation plate.
